source: BDS 1.26.60.6 Linux, read from memory at startup: each Block's collision component (data-driven boxes; disabled = no collision) and, for block types whose collision code is BlockType's own, the type's shape. Blocks whose type computes its shape in code are listed under computed with the methods it overrides and, once read from BDS's code, the rule Helix ports it as; their shapes are not data.
